answerability.question: Which Git repository keeps Cedar previous document versions?

evidence.text: Cedar stores document version history in its Git repository. Cedar also writes preservation copies to OCFL storage. Both mechanisms are used together.

answerability.question: Which cloud service stores Birch backups?

evidence.text: Birch stores its database metadata on a local disk. Birch backups are stored in the S3 cloud service.

answerability.question: Which Git server stores Cedar previous files?

evidence.text: NovaPay keeps file histories in OCFL without Git.

evidence.text: Rejected Cedar proposal: migrate retained document histories from Git to OCFL. This proposal was not adopted.

answerability.question: Which SQL database holds Arbor archive originals?

evidence.text: Arbor does not store archive originals in a SQL database. Arbor preserves originals in independent filesystem objects. SQL stores derived search metadata only.

answerability.question: Is Git necessary to restore an earlier Harbor file?

evidence.text: Harbor stores independent file histories in OCFL without Git. Earlier versions are downloadable directly.

answerability.question: Which Git server hosts retained files in Cedar?

evidence.text: Cedar preserves original files and every prior version in OCFL without Git.
